name_decision: KEEP "PLAY BEFORE PIXELS" as the brand, the website name (playbeforepixels.com) and the Maryland trade name of AlphaPlay LLC. On the four judge lenses Puddlefort totals 28/40 against 27/40 for Play Before Pixels. That one-point lead does not meet the test of being "clearly better on balance AND lower legal risk," for three reasons. (1) Puddlefort's 8/10 legal score comes from a name nobody has searched: no USPTO, WIPO, TMview or marketplace search was ever run on it, per the trademark lane (https://branddb.wipo.int/, confirmed=false). Its lower risk is therefore UNVERIFIED. (2) On the user's actual goal, getting international buyers to the website, Play Before Pixels wins clearly. It scores 9 on audience fit and 8 on memorability/search against Puddlefort's 7 and 7. The name is what parents and teachers type into a search box, and "puddle" is weak vocabulary for non-native speakers. (3) The business is already set up around it. legal/ENTITY.md lists Play Before Pixels as the DBA of AlphaPlay LLC, and the trademark lane warns that a third brand name adds more filing and upkeep cost (https://www.uspto.gov/trademarks/basics, UNVERIFIED). The name's real weakness is legal. It describes the message, so it risks a failure-to-function refusal (TMEP 1202.04, https://tmep.uspto.gov/RDMS/TMEP/current#/current/TMEP-1200d1e1.html, UNVERIFIED). It is handled this way: (a) run a knockout search, then get an attorney clearance opinion; (b) always use it as a brand (book imprint, site header, neck labels), not only as a slogan; (c) file in classes 16 and 41 only at first; (d) keep Puddlefort as the named fallback and hold puddlefort.com ($10.50–11.50) until the attorney's opinion arrives. Switch to Puddlefort only if the attorney's opinion on PLAY BEFORE PIXELS comes back unfavorable AND a knockout search on Puddlefort comes back clean. Dropped outright: Tinkerlark (high conflict risk, and "tinker" is a slur in the UK and Ireland), Rootling ("root" is vulgar slang in Australia and the name is known as a Minecraft creature), Wonderlap (an existing laptop accessory uses it, and "lap" reads as "laptop"), and Paperlark (an existing Etsy seller in the same digital-download channel: https://www.etsy.com/shop/PaperLarkDesigns).

5. Hopstone: 5 / 5 / 6 / 5 = 21  (existing surname, so a surname refusal is possible; reads like beer/brewery; https://www.fcoplaw.com/attorneys/joshua-hopstone/)

Decision rule applied: keep Play Before Pixels unless an alternative is clearly better AND lower legal risk. Puddlefort's lead is 1 point and rests on an unsearched legal score, so the rule is not met.
name_risks: Weak, descriptive mark. PLAY BEFORE PIXELS states a message, so the USPTO could refuse it as informational matter that does not function as a brand (TMEP 1202.04; https://tmep.uspto.gov/RDMS/TMEP/current#/current/TMEP-1200d1e1.html). Rated MEDIUM risk by the trademark lane, UNVERIFIED. Mitigation: use it as a brand (imprint, header, labels) and file classes 16 and 41 first.

International dependency. A Madrid international registration depends on the US application for 5 years, so if the US mark is refused, the EU, UK, Canadian and Australian coverage falls with it (https://www.wipo.int/madrid/en/, UNVERIFIED). Do not file Madrid until the US application looks safe, or knowingly accept the risk.

Look-alike slogan already in use. pencilsbeforepixels.com is registered and hosted by someone else (DNS check 2026-09-27/28, legal/domain-portfolio.md). Hold the 'Pencils before pixels' slogan off all products and listings until it has been cleared. It could also send traffic to the other site.

Other slogan domains are taken: screenscanwait.com, childhoodcantwait.com and paperfirst.com all have live DNS delegations (legal/domain-portfolio.md). Clear 'Childhood can't wait. Screens can.' and 'Paper first' before printing merch (https://tmsearch.uspto.gov/).
Slogans on shirts invite ornamental and failure-to-function refusals in class 25 (TMEP 1202.03, UNVERIFIED). Treat all 8 slogans as marketing copy. Put the house brand on neck labels or hang tags.

Search ambiguity. Without quotes, 'play' and 'pixels' read as gaming terms, and listeners may type 'Play Before Screens' or 'People Before Pixels' (memorability judge, UNVERIFIED). Mitigation: use the exact phrase in every book subtitle and in site titles. playbeforescreens.com is an optional defensive buy.

X/Twitter handle length. 'playbeforepixels' is 16 characters, one over X's 15-character limit (https://help.x.com/en/managing-your-account/x-username-rules, UNVERIFIED). Use @playb4pixels and register playb4pixels.com as a redirect.

A DBA and a domain give no trademark rights. The Maryland trade-name filing and owning playbeforepixels.com do not stop others from using the phrase. Only use and a USPTO registration do (https://www.uspto.gov/trademarks/basics, UNVERIFIED).

LEGAL-LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md item 24 conflicts with this plan: it proposes filing classes 16, 25, 28 and 41. Change it to 16 and 41 first. Add 25 only for label (brand) use, and 28 only if the deck is sold as a game.

The research hub name 'The Virtual Autism Project' carries health-claim risk. virtualautism.org already hosts a live Wix site (legal/domain-portfolio.md), and the FTC requires competent and reliable scientific evidence for health claims (https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/health-products-compliance-guidance, UNVERIFIED). Rename it to a non-medical title at playbeforepixels.com/research, and send any decision to keep the name to counsel.

The name is not confirmed clear anywhere. No USPTO, WIPO Brand DB or TMview search has been run on any candidate (every trademark-lane item is confirmed=false). A founder knockout and an attorney clearance are required before launch.

The most common .com typo worldwide. Cloudflare's docs name .co (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-docs/production/src/content/docs/registrar/troubleshooting.mdx). 301 redirect.

trademark_plan:
Every step below is GATED on a go-ahead from the founder's own employment counsel (legal/FOR-EMPLOYMENT-COUNSEL.md, Q4–Q7 and Q15). Nothing is to be researched against the employer or its records, and no school-system employee is to be contacted.

STEP 0, calendar it now. The existing ALPHAPLAY intent-to-use application (Serial 99650345; classes 9, 16, 25, 28 and 41, limited to spelling and literacy goods and pinnies) received a Notice of Allowance on Sept 8, 2026, according to legal/ENTITY.md (not independently verified). The Statement of Use or Extension is due MARCH 8, 2027. Set a reminder for January 2027, and check status at https://tsdr.uspto.gov/#caseNumber=99650345&caseType=SERIAL_NO&searchType=statusSearch. Missing the deadline abandons the application. Costs: extension about $125 per class; Statement of Use about $150 per class (UNVERIFIED). ALPHAPLAY's goods list can only be narrowed, never broadened, so it cannot cover the Play Before Pixels books, course or merch. Ignore private 'notices' from companies such as Markavo, CopyMark or TCLP (https://www.uspto.gov/trademarks/protect/caution-misleading-notices).

STEP 1, $0, about 30 minutes, before launch. Founder knockout search in USPTO Trademark Search (https://tmsearch.uspto.gov/) for PLAY BEFORE PIXELS, PLAY B4 PIXELS, *BEFORE PIXELS and PLAY BEFORE SCREENS in classes 9, 16, 25, 28, 35 and 41. Then WIPO Global Brand Database (https://branddb.wipo.int/) and TMview (https://www.tmdn.org/tmview/) for the EU, UK, Canada and Australia. Then Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Etsy, Amazon and Google Books. Run the same search on Puddlefort as the fallback.

STEP 2, about $500–$2,500 per name (UNVERIFIED). An attorney's full clearance search and opinion. The same attorney handles the ALPHAPLAY Statement of Use or extension decision, and checks whether the '11140 Rockville Pike, Suite 100-559' address meets the USPTO domicile rule. A mail drop cannot be the domicile, but it can stay the public mailing address (37 CFR 2.189 / TMEP 803.05, UNVERIFIED).

STEP 3, within 90 days. File PLAY BEFORE PIXELS with AlphaPlay LLC as applicant, subject to the counsel flag. File through USPTO Trademark Center, not TEAS, with identity verification (https://www.uspto.gov/trademarks/apply, UNVERIFIED). Start with class 16 (printed books, guides, cards) and class 41 (courses, workshop-kit education, educational website). Use pre-approved ID Manual wording (https://idm-tmng.uspto.gov/id-master-list-public.html) to avoid the $200 surcharges. Cost: about $700 ($350 per class), plus about $150 per class for the Statement of Use (https://www.uspto.gov/learning-and-resources/fees-and-payment/uspto-fee-schedule, UNVERIFIED; confirm on the day of filing). Add class 9 when e-books or printables launch. Add class 28 only if the deck is a game, and class 25 only for label (brand) use. Defer class 35. List only goods she genuinely intends to sell. Keep dated, real specimens: no mockups.

STEP 4, international, within 6 months of the US filing (Paris priority). Madrid designations for the EU, UK, Canada and Australia in 2 classes, about $2,500–$4,500 including the WIPO basic fee of about CHF 653 and the USPTO certification fee of about $100 per class (https://www.wipo.int/madrid/en/, UNVERIFIED). File only once the US application looks safe, because of the 5-year dependency on the US application. A Canadian or Australian registration also unlocks the .ca and .com.au domains.

STEP 5, slogans. Treat them as marketing copy. If one tagline is ever filed, use 'Childhood can't wait. Screens can.' in class 41. Hold 'Pencils before pixels' until it is cleared. Before listing any slogan product, search each slogan on USPTO, Etsy and Amazon.

STEP 6, marking. Use TM now. Use (R) only after registration, and only for the goods registered (15 U.S.C. 1111, UNVERIFIED). ALPHAPLAY may not use (R) yet. Amazon Brand Registry reportedly accepts pending applications, but confirm on Amazon's own page first (UNVERIFIED).

Update LEGAL-LAUNCH-CHECKLIST.md item 24 to match Step 3.
legal_must_before_launch: Send legal/FOR-EMPLOYMENT-COUNSEL.md to the founder's OWN employment attorney and get the go-ahead before selling, marketing, publishing her name, filing trademarks or filing the ALPHAPLAY Statement of Use. Flag only: do not research the employer and do not contact school-system staff.

Confirm AlphaPlay LLC is in good standing on the SDAT Business Entity Search. File any overdue $300 Annual Report / Personal Property Return (due April 15) (https://dat.maryland.gov/businesses/Pages/Annual-Report-Filing-Requirement.aspx, UNVERIFIED).

File 'Play Before Pixels' as a Maryland trade name of AlphaPlay LLC (about $25 for 5 years) through Maryland Business Express (https://egov.maryland.gov/BusinessExpress, UNVERIFIED). Use the LLC's EIN, never a personal SSN, on marketplaces (https://www.irs.gov/businesses/small-businesses-self-employed/apply-for-an-employer-identification-number-ein-online, UNVERIFIED).

Add retail and digital sales to the LLC's Maryland Comptroller registration: 6% on goods and on digital products, and a CPA ruling on how the 3% IT/data tax applies to the course and printables (https://www.marylandtaxes.gov, UNVERIFIED). Etsy and TpT collect as marketplace facilitators. KDP, IngramSpark and Bookshop.org are the retailers for her sales. Faire orders are wholesale and need resale certificates (https://www.streamlinedsalestax.org/, UNVERIFIED).
Run the trademark knockout search (USPTO, WIPO Brand DB, TMview, social platforms, marketplaces), then get the attorney clearance opinion on PLAY BEFORE PIXELS (https://tmsearch.uspto.gov/).

Remove every health, medical, developmental-outcome and speech-therapy claim in every language. The founder is not an SLP. Rename the 'Virtual Autism Project' hub to a non-medical title at /research, with a published disclaimer. Name no school, district, company or EdTech product (https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/health-products-compliance-guidance, UNVERIFIED).

Have an attorney review the policy pages (Privacy, Terms, Shipping/Returns/Refunds, Affiliate & Endorsement Disclosure, Accessibility Statement), about $500–$2,000 flat (estimate). Fill in [DOMAIN] and the bracketed choices. Remove COACHING-WORKSHOP-TERMS.md or cut it down to a license for host-it-yourself workshop kits: BRAND.md rule 19 and CLAUDE.md ban coaching and live services (file:///home/user/playbeforepixels/brand/BRAND.md).

COPPA: keep every page addressed to adults. No child accounts, sign-ups, uploads or kid-facing interactive pages. The amended rule has required compliance since April 22, 2026 (https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/complying-coppa-frequently-asked-questions, UNVERIFIED).

Cookie/device-storage audit of the live site: check Shopify, YouTube embeds and email widgets. ePrivacy Art. 5(3) and UK PECR cover any storage on the visitor's device, so 'cookieless analytics' alone does not remove the need for a banner. The attorney decides whether a banner is needed (https://www.edpb.europa.eu/our-work-tools/documents/public-consultations/2023/guidelines-22023-technical-scope-art-53-eprivacy_en, UNVERIFIED).

Publish the Privacy Policy (CalOPPA requires one regardless of size). Sell no data, run no ad pixels, collect no child data, and have the attorney confirm Connecticut's July 1, 2026 sensitive-data amendment does not apply (https://oag.ca.gov/privacy/privacy-laws, UNVERIFIED).

Email: double opt-in; a CASL-compliant sign-up form (identify the sender, give contact information, state that subscribers can unsubscribe); the Rockville mailbox as the postal address in every footer; opt-outs honored within 10 business days (https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/can-spam-act-compliance-guide-business, UNVERIFIED).

Keep books purely paper and paperboard, and put CPSIA tracking information (publisher, city, printing date/batch) on the copyright page. Confirm with a product-safety attorney (https://www.cpsc.gov/Business--Manufacturing/Business-Education/Business-Guidance/Childrens-Books, UNVERIFIED).

Keep the classroom resource pack (the 'teacher pack') unlisted on EVERY channel, including the Gumroad launch list in commerce/storefront-setup-guide.md section 13, until employment counsel answers (file:///home/user/playbeforepixels/commerce/storefront-setup-guide.md).

Register the core domains to AlphaPlay LLC, not personally. Cloudflare DNS is required and fees are non-refundable (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-docs/production/src/content/partials/registrar/requirements.mdx, confirmed).
legal_before_first_sale: Sell digital products internationally through ONE merchant of record so EU/UK VAT (owed from the first sale by non-EU sellers), AU/CA/NZ GST and the EU consumer-law duties are handled. Use Gumroad per the commerce guide, about 10% + $0.50 per sale, or Payhip only if it confirms in writing that it is the VAT seller of record (https://gumroad.com/pricing, https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/taxation/vat/vat-e-commerce/one-stop-shop_en, UNVERIFIED). Never use both.

EU/UK 14-day withdrawal. Add an unticked, required checkbox for immediate access to digital content, with the buyer's acknowledgment that the right is lost, and repeat both in the confirmation email. From June 19, 2026, EU web sales also need an online 'withdraw from contract here' function (Directive (EU) 2023/2673, Art. 11a: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/dir/2023/2673/oj/eng, UNVERIFIED). Get written confirmation that the merchant of record provides it. The refund page's '30% completed' condition cannot reduce the statutory right.

EU GPSR. Block direct physical shipping to the EU (and Northern Ireland) unless the distributor or marketplace acts as the EU responsible person, or an EU responsible-person service is hired for about €100–600 a year (Regulation (EU) 2023/988: https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2023/988/oj/eng, UNVERIFIED).

Books abroad. Publish on KDP's own Amazon marketplaces and on IngramSpark with the founder's own Bowker ISBNs: 10 for about $295, publisher AlphaPlay LLC (https://www.myidentifiers.com/get-your-isbn-now, UNVERIFIED). Turn KDP Expanded Distribution OFF for any ISBN that is also on IngramSpark (https://kdp.amazon.com/en_US/help/topic/G201834180, UNVERIFIED).

Publish the affiliate disclosure with Amazon's exact wording, 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.', and put a disclosure next to every affiliate link (https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/ftcs-endorsement-guides-what-people-are-asking, UNVERIFIED).

Reviews: only real testimonials given with consent, and no incentives tied to positive reviews. This covers the FTC rule (16 CFR Part 465, up to $53,088 per violation) and the UK DMCC Act fake-review ban from April 6, 2025 (https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2024/08/federal-trade-commission-announces-final-rule-banning-fake-reviews-testimonials, UNVERIFIED).

Any membership or subscription: show clear terms before billing, get express consent, make online cancellation as easy as sign-up, and send renewal reminders (ROSCA and state auto-renewal laws, including California AB 2863) (https://www.ftc.gov/legal-library/browse/rules/negative-option-rule, UNVERIFIED).
Slogan clearance before any merch listing. Search each slogan on USPTO (classes 25/16/21), Etsy and Amazon. Hold 'Pencils before pixels' (https://tmsearch.uspto.gov/).

Merch: launch with ADULT sizes only. Kids' apparel needs a CPSIA CPC, lead testing of the inks, flammability compliance and tracking labels, and CPSC eFiling applies from July 8, 2026. Decide the card deck's target age before printing, because it may be treated as a toy (https://www.cpsc.gov/Business--Manufacturing/Testing-Certification/Childrens-Product-Certificate, UNVERIFIED). Outside the US, hold the card deck and hold EU board-book sales until a toy-classification opinion is obtained (https://single-market-economy.ec.europa.eu/sectors/toys/toy-safety_en, UNVERIFIED).

Canada: confirm the POD partner's bilingual fibre-content labels and dealer identity (or register a CA number) (https://competition-bureau.canada.ca/, UNVERIFIED). Do not target Quebec until the French site exists.
Australia/NZ: keep the 'your local consumer rights apply' sentence and never show 'no refunds' (https://www.accc.gov.au/, UNVERIFIED).

Accessibility: build to WCAG 2.1 AA, make e-books accessible (they fall under the EU Accessibility Act), and publish the Accessibility Statement (https://www.ada.gov/resources/web-guidance/, UNVERIFIED).

Get general liability insurance with products coverage (about $400–$900 a year, estimate), naming AlphaPlay LLC d/b/a Play Before Pixels (https://www.sba.gov/business-guide/launch-your-business/get-business-insurance).

Track direct sales by US state against economic-nexus thresholds, and by country each month against AU A$75,000, CA C$30,000 and NZ NZ$60,000 (UNVERIFIED; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ibericode/vat-rates/master/vat-rates.json for the EU rates, which were confirmed).

Within 90 days: register copyright for each book, the guide and the deck art ($65 Standard Application for LLC-owned works; https://www.copyright.gov/about/fees.html, UNVERIFIED), and calendar the ALPHAPLAY deadline of March 8, 2027.
international_plan_summary:
Goal: buyers in any country can find playbeforepixels.com and complete a purchase there. The plan follows legal/international-plan.md (DRAFT, corrected 2026-09-28).

ONE SITE, NO GUESSWORK. Run a single global .com. All country domains 301-redirect to it. Languages go in subfolders (/es/, /fr/, /de/, /pt-br/), never on separate sites. Astro's i18n and @astrojs/sitemap generate the hreflang alternates, but NOT x-default, which must be added by hand (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/withastro/docs/main/src/content/docs/en/guides/integrations-guide/sitemap.mdx, confirmed). Never auto-redirect by IP address. Cloudflare Pages cannot redirect by country anyway (confirmed). Instead, turn on IP Geolocation (available on the Free plan) and use request.cf.country to power a 'Buy in your country' page and a suggestion banner (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-docs/production/src/content/docs/workers/runtime-apis/request.mdx, confirmed).

GET FOUND. Set up a Google Search Console Domain property with the sitemap, a Bing Webmaster Tools import, and Cloudflare Crawler Hints, which sends updates to IndexNow on all plans (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-docs/production/src/content/docs/cache/advanced-configuration/crawler-hints.mdx, confirmed). Add Merchant Center free listings, digital products first. On the day the domain is added, set Cloudflare AI-bot policy to Search = Allow and Agent = Allow: new domains since Sept 15, 2026 default to blocking Training and Agent bots on pages with ads (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cloudflare/cloudflare-docs/production/src/content/docs/bots/additional-configurations/block-ai-bots.mdx, confirmed). Print the URL on back covers, copyright pages, hang tags, packing inserts and social profiles. Add it to marketplace listings only where each platform's rules allow outside links (UNVERIFIED). Skip Baidu, Yandex, Naver and Seznam.

THREE WAYS TO BUY. (A) Digital products worldwide through one merchant of record, which handles VAT/GST, the EU waiver checkbox and the withdrawal button. (B) Physical goods abroad through marketplaces that print or stock locally: KDP's Amazon stores, IngramSpark's global network, Etsy, and POD routed to in-region facilities. EU direct physical sales wait for GPSR. (C) Direct physical shipping to the US only at launch: the EU's €3-per-item duty from July 1, 2026 and the end of US de minimis in Aug 2025 make cross-border parcels costly (https://taxation-customs.ec.europa.eu/, UNVERIFIED).

MARKET ORDER. Tier 1: US, UK, Canada, Australia. Tier 2: Ireland, New Zealand. Tier 3: Spanish, starting with US Hispanic families. Tier 4: French/Quebec and German. Brazilian Portuguese, digital only, comes later. Translation: Spanish in months 4–9, French and German in months 9–18, about $5,000 per language using AI plus a professional post-edit (estimate). Merch slogans stay in English. Every translator gets the do-not-say list (no health, medical or therapy terms), and none is hired from the founder's school system.

Abroad, launch parent-facing products ONLY. The classroom pack and educator kits stay held until employment counsel answers. There is no coaching and no live service in any market (BRAND.md rule 19).

Nearly every legal or tax fact in this plan is UNVERIFIED because official sites were blocked. A cross-border accountant and the attorney confirm them before launch.
